notes.title: Burning Passion – SEX Amnesia - Lover Sim is Just Around the Corner! 🔥
notes.content:
[h3]We’re putting the final touches on [b]SEX Amnesia - Lover Sim[/b]🔞, and while we need just a bit more time to make it perfect, we’re thrilled to announce that [b]the game officially drops this Saturday! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235364/225c18e522a71d648e333bba3c48947480f306dc.png[/img]

Get ready for a rollercoaster of emotions—one moment, you're living the dream with your perfect girlfriend, and the next, your whole world goes up in flames (literally). When she finally wakes up from a coma… she doesn’t remember you. Now, it’s up to you to [b]rekindle your lost love, rediscover your passion, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows[/b].

This isn't just a love story—it's [b]a mystery, a second chance, and a journey through sizzling romance and dangerous truths[/b]. Your choices shape the outcome, from deep, emotional moments to the hottest encounters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235364/05baf12905373be8b862cff3d75a2fdb4ed9e7fa.png[/img]

Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and prepare for a wild, unforgettable ride when SEX Amnesia - Lover Sim launches this Saturday!

Trust us, you don’t wanna miss this. 💦[/h3]

notes.title: Get Ready – SEX Amnesia: Lover Sim is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Prepare to immerse yourself in an emotional journey - SEX Amnesia: Lover Sim launches in just a few weeks, bringing an unforgettable visual novel experience. 

Explore the life of a protagonist whose perfect world is shattered in an instant. After a tragic fire leaves your girlfriend in a coma, she wakes up with no memory of you. 

Rebuild your relationship from scratch – from heartfelt first dates to rediscovering intimacy – all while unraveling a mystery that threatens to change everything.

Explore branching dialogues, unravel hidden truths, and make choices that shape your destiny. Will you protect your love and reclaim the happiness you’ve lost, or will the past’s dark secrets tear you apart?

[u]Wishlist the game now and prepare for a story packed with romance, suspense, and unforgettable 18+ moments. [/u]

[b]The countdown has begun – are you ready for the journey?[/b][/h3]
